name: onebackend
description: Single gateway that fronts 5 backends (aligaah, crunz, ezone, underdwag, isosmack) on one port. Each service keeps its own database and routes under a unique path prefix.

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n gateway,aligaah,crunz,ezone,underdwag,isosmack -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,red "node gateway.js" "cd services/aligaah && npm start" "cd services/crunz && npm start" "cd services/ezone && npm start" "cd services/underdwag && npm start" "cd services/isosmack && npm start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,aligaah,crunz,ezone,underdwag,isosmack -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,red "nodemon gateway.js" "cd services/aligaah && npm run dev" "cd services/crunz && npm run dev" "cd services/ezone && npm run dev" "cd services/underdwag && npm run dev" "cd services/isosmack && npm run dev"
